aboutModal.desc: A local session manager for the Antigravity App and Antigravity CLI.
aboutModal.title: About

sessionViewer.batchDeleteConfirmMessage: Permanently delete {count} selected session records from their local sources, including known message data, logs, and index entries? Sessions in use cannot be deleted. This cannot be undone.
sessionViewer.confirmAppCache: Also empty the Antigravity App's browser cache.
sessionViewer.confirmCcSwitch: Also remove matching sync records from CC Switch and its backups (usage history is kept).
sessionViewer.confirmFailed: Could not open the deletion confirmation: {error}
sessionViewer.deleteOtherSources: This session ID also has records in other sources. To remove it from CC Switch after a refresh, search for its ID under All sources and delete all matching records together.
sessionViewer.deleteWarnings: Some related data could not be cleaned:
sessionViewer.indexOnlyHint: This source has only index entries for this session; its files are gone or are stored in another source. Delete it to stop other tools from listing it here.
sessionViewer.noMessages: No messages available for this session
sessionViewer.noSessions: No Antigravity App or Antigravity CLI sessions found
sessionViewer.optionAppCacheHint: Empty the Antigravity App's Cache and Code Cache folders, which can hold session IDs. They are rebuilt automatically, so the next launch is a little slower.
sessionViewer.optionCcSwitchHint: Remove sync records for selected and missing sessions from ~/.cc-switch and its backups. Works while CC Switch is running; usage and cost history is kept.
sessionViewer.recoveryPending: These stores have an interrupted cleanup that could not be recovered. If the Antigravity App or Antigravity CLI is running, quit both and refresh:
sessionViewer.selectToView: Select a session to view its messages
sessionViewer.title: Session management

pluginModal.title: Usage plugin
pluginModal.desc: Records content, tokens, cache, speed, and cost for each model request from local session stores without uploading data.
pluginModal.uninstalled: Uninstalled. Usage history stays in Antigravity's plugin data.
pluginModal.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall Anti-Power Usage? Usage history is kept and comes back if you reinstall.
pluginModal.catalogUpdated: Prices updated. The plugin recalculates costs on its own.
pluginModal.restart: Antigravity is running. Restart it for the change to take effect.
pluginModal.enable: Turn the plugin on under Customizations → Installed in Antigravity, then open it from the side panel.
pluginModal.foreign: The plugin folder is occupied by something else, so Anti-Power leaves it alone.
pluginModal.missingBundle: This Anti-Power build does not include the plugin.
